# plot_framework_as_mesh { #mofography.visualize.plot_framework_as_mesh }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-recommended">go-to</span> Default mesh framework trace in show_mof_plotly and workflow gallery figures.

```python
visualize.plot_framework_as_mesh(
    ase_atoms,
    show_rings=True,
    stylize=False,
    kwargs_frame_mesh=dict(showlegend=True, showscale=False, name='Framework', legendgroup='framework', legendgrouptitle_text='Framework'),
    kwargs_mesh_for_atoms={},
    kwargs_aromatic_rings={},
)
```

Return Plotly Mesh3d traces for the framework and optional aromatic rings.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name              | Type   | Description                                                                                   | Default                                                                                                                |
|-------------------|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| ase_atoms         |        | an ase.Atoms object                                                                           | _required_                                                                                                             |
| show_rings        |        | if True, will plotO the aromatic rings as well, defaults to True (optional)                   | `True`                                                                                                                 |
| stylize           |        | if True, will apply some lighting and other effects to the mesh, defaults to False (optional) | `False`                                                                                                                |
| kwargs_frame_mesh |        | keyword arguments for mesh_for_atoms                                                          | `dict(showlegend=True, showscale=False, name='Framework', legendgroup='framework', legendgrouptitle_text='Framework')` |
| kwargs_highlight  |        | keyword arguments for plot_aromatic_rings                                                     | _required_                                                                                                             |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description               |
|--------|--------|---------------------------|
|        |        | A tuple of plotly traces. |
